title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI metrics integration and quality gating enhancements
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: reduce regressions at the prompt-set level by surfacing per-prompt eval metrics in CI and adding automatic gating for regressions. Large rollouts have occasionally regressed on a small subset of critical prompts; this PR wires per-prompt statistics into the eval CI pipeline, adds configurable thresholds for fails/alerts, and improves PR reporting so engineers can triage quickly.

What changed: integrated a per-prompt metrics step into the eval CI (eval-metrics job), added a gating layer that compares current run to baseline for target metrics (exact-match, BLEU-like score, and toxicity guardrails), and improved PR comment output with a compact table and links to the failing prompt examples. Also added a lightweight allowlist/ignore configuration and a feature flag to toggle strict gating during experiments.

Files of interest: eval-harness/ci/per_prompt_metrics.py, eval-harness/ci/reporting/pr_commenter.py, ci/workflows/eval-ci.yml, eval-harness/evals/per_prompt/registry.yaml, tests/eval/test_per_prompt_metrics.py.

Checklist:
- [x] Add per-prompt metrics collector and serializer
- [x] Add gating logic and config (thresholds + allowlist)
- [x] Add PR comment summarizer with compact failure view
- [x] Wire job into eval CI workflow and validate with integration tests
- [x] Documentation snippet in eval-harness/README.md

Testing and CI: initial CI run failed due to missing baseline file path handling; fixed in second commit. Local unit tests for the per-prompt aggregator added and pass. Integration run against a synthetic baseline demonstrates correct detection of a 6.5% degradation on "billing/overdraft-prompts" and flags it when threshold set to 5%.

Rollout plan: ship gated but behind feature flag (eval_gating.enable_per_prompt = false by default). Enable for canary orgs next week, monitor eval failure rate and false-positive rate for two weeks, then flip default to true if stable.

Related: ENG-1423, ENG-1987.

Notes: This PR focuses on CI-side gating and reporting; follow-up PR will add dashboarding hooks (traces + per-prompt time series) and tighter integration with the rollout service for automated rollback policies.
